reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: I wish the app didn’t feel so pay to use. I just want to encourage the use of getting into the Bible but it feels like every action I do costs money. Or even to access the app for free users it doesn’t allow me to not pass through free paywalls without just exiting and going to free mode. Even in free mode I want to use the app for Bible study groups but it only allows 4 people to be in a group at a time. I love the app if it was allowing more people in a group and less pay walls.

reviews.title: Payment Terms
reviews.text:
I don’t mind paying for this app. I think you deserve to be paid for the great work you put in, whether it’s for the gospel or not.

reviews.title: Makes Accountability Fun
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I are long distance this app is such a fun, unique way to share what the Lord has been teaching us in our own secret space. I love being able to take a picture of what I’m currently reading and studying and then share this summary and application my boyfriend. We’ve only been using it for a couple of days, but I already feel much more accountable to get in my word and snap a cute pic!! There are a couple bugs with the keyboard feature when I’m writing out a long reflection it won’t let me easily edit the text since the keyboard blocks the bulk of it. Other than that, I’m definitely loving it so far and the widgets are super fun!
